final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / rental_duration) AS per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_rate) AS mean_rate FROM rating_stats) SELECT AVG(rs.avg_length) AS avg_length, AVG(rs.per_day_rate) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(rs.per_day_rate - rm.mean_rate) AS avg_excess FROM rating_stats AS rs CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS rm WHERE rs.per_day_rate > rm.mean_rate
